bullets: I see we made $20,040.85 CAD from 108 orders, averaging $185.56 per order, which tells me customers are willing to spend on quality globes when they buy.
Just 3 products drove our top sales, led by the 16-Inch Inflatable Blue Ocean Globe with 13 units, so I think featuring these bestsellers more could boost revenue further.
116 of our 166 products have not sold a single unit yet, which means a lot of our catalog is not getting attention and may need better promotion or review.
insight.question: Should I create bundles or discounts to push the 116 unsold products, starting with a few?
